cyberattack: Other: CMS/repository enumeration and security-relevant probing; bypass unproven
data.description: The Navy history-site index contains 3,804 captures of 2,477 URLs, including systematic guessed metadata filenames and security-relevant CMS routes. Verification covered 252 distinct bodies behind 358 JSON-looking HTTP-200 captures; 21 contain actual repository/asset metadata, including descriptions, audit identifiers and paths. Broader QueryBuilder requests were denied and author/editor routes failed. Metadata access is not automatically an unauthorized disclosure; historical createdBy values do not confer current administrator access. Some JSON routes are normal frontend behavior, and alternate-path controls returned already-public objects. No successful bypass, injection, modification, operational military access or AI attribution was established.
data.summary: Archived Navy history-site traffic shows systematic CMS-route and filename probing, returning real asset metadata while broad queries and author routes failed. Successful access-control bypass, injection, nonpublic military-data access and AI attribution are unproven.
